description:
This image is a screenshot of the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) CLC+ Core web application, displaying the interface for managing and publishing a land use/land cover (LULC) data extraction instance. The main title bar reads "Extraction 'CLC+ Instance_LULUCF_2021_NL'". Above the main title, the navigation breadcrumbs show "Data Catalogue / Extraction 'CLC+ Instance_LULUCF_2021_NL'". Action buttons are visible at the top: "EXTRACTED", "REPUBLISH ON GEOSERVER", "START EXTRACTION", "DOWNLOAD", and "PUBLISH".

The left panel, labeled "General Information", details the data extraction:
- Name: "CLC+ Instance_LULUCF_2021_NL"
- Country: "Netherlands/Nederland"
- Region: "Groningen"
- Reference Year: "2018"
- Time Range of Extracted Data: "01.12.2018 - 31.12.2018"
- INSPIRE (Infrastructure for Spatial Information in the European Community) Themes: "LU Land use", "LC Land cover"
- Created By: "User Admin/Support CLC+ Core"
- Organisation/s: "European Environment Agency"

A modal dialog, titled "Publish Extraction 'CLC+ Instance_LULUCF_2021_NL'", is overlaid on the interface. It states: "Publishing 'CLC+ Instance_LULUCF_2021_NL' will make it accessible for other users within CLC+ Core according to the visibility that you define - Please select the preferred visibility setting:". The user is presented with three visibility options: "Public - All Organisations", "National - Countries of selected Organisations", and "Private - Selected Organisations". Buttons labeled "CANCEL" and "PUBLISH" are at the bottom of this dialog.

The right panel shows a geographic map centered on the northern Netherlands and parts of Germany, with the region "NL11 Groningen" highlighted. Key cities visible on the map include Emden, Esens, Norden, Aurich, Wilhelmshaven, Bremen, Oldenburg, and Groningen. A scale bar indicates "30 km" and "10 mi". The map's attribution reads: "Leaflet | Core003 Mosaic. © OpenStreetMap contributors". Below the map, "Input Classes", "100%", "Eagle", and "Show" are visible. The system tray displays the time "20:45" and date "16.12.2023".
